mapper.select: SELECT POPUP_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_YMD, END_YMD, LINK_URL, USE_YN, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, REGIST_DT FROM POPUP WHERE POPUP_ID = #{popupId}

SELECT POPUP_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, ATCH_FILE_GRPID FROM POPUP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND START_YMD <= REPLACE(CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') AND END_YMD >= REPLACE(CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS VARCHAR(10)), '-', '') ORDER BY REGIST_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POPUP ( POPUP_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_YMD, END_YMD, LINK_URL, USE_YN, ATCH_FILE_GRPID, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{popupId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startYmd}, #{endYmd}, #{linkUrl}, #{useYn}, #{atchFileGrpid}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE POPUP SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_YMD = #{startYmd}, END_YMD = #{endYmd}, LINK_URL = #{linkUrl}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, ATCH_FILE_GRPID = #{atchFileGrpid}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE POPUP_ID = #{popupId}
